mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.defect_id, f.original_name, f.content_type, f.size_bytes, f.storage_key, f.uploaded_by, f.uploaded_at, a.name AS uploaded_by_name FROM defect_attachment f JOIN account a ON a.id = f.uploaded_by WHERE f.defect_id = #{defectId} ORDER BY f.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defect_attachment (defect_id, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, storage_key, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{defectId}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{storageKey}, #{uploadedBy})
